scope.summary: Server diagnosability: doctor --online --verbose reports the connect phase (AuthTtc/Tcp/Wallet), ORA code and a phase-appropriate hint (never the connect-string hint after ACCEPT); planted password/token/OCID/DSN canaries never appear in verbose doctor output or stderr; MCP tool envelopes stay 'driver detail suppressed' even with ORACLEMCP_CONNECT_DETAIL=1; request span ids match between local log and OTLP.
